info.name: VacQ Final Project FR1-9 A1-A13 Pu
info.description: Run in order on a disposable test database. Creates 2 demo users and a uniquely named room. Last request removes the room and its remaining near-start booking. Accounts remain because the product has no account-delete API. See README for setup and limits.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('adminEmail') || !pm.environment.get('adminPassword')) throw new Error('Set adminEmail/adminPassword in the local Postman environment first. Use npm run create-admin.');
